mods.title: HYPNO'S LULLABY REBOOT [Demo]
mods.description: Boyfriend is missing late at night, and you, Girlfriend, are out looking for him. Mind laiden with panic, head swimming with thought"Oh where could he be? perhaps our favourite spot?"And as sun met horizon, the night fast encroaching...A sound from the distance, and slowly approaching.A call from the fog, a beckoning voice...Why don't you come closer, you don't have a choice."To hell with it" you speak aloud, and advance.You put one foot forward, and enter my dance...So into the darkness, and into the black.Not knowing, or caring, if you'll ever come back.- - Available for Mac, Windows, and Linux!A demo for the official reboot of the Poképasta mod Hypno's Lullaby V2, FNF Lullaby was passed down to newer leadership, featuring legacy developers still in play. Its been a long time coming to ensure the game is brought back alive, birthed in a new light. I can't help but be proud of each and every single member that contributed and came along with us through the full journey. Enter the grand shop that is the Cabinet of Novelties, and aid the ever illustrious Collector in his journey to, well, collect magical artifacts. Your paycheck? Endless entertainment in the form of bootleg cartridges imbued with suffering essence. Become a Collectoree! For more information, visit cabinetofnovelties.com.For those who are struggling with the fangame's mechanics; the Collector offers his services localized in the shop's Console settings under Misc, titled "Baby Mode."This fangame was made using Rubicon Engine, a Godot FNF Engine.- - For immediate advanced settings:Windows/LinuxCTRL + ALT + SMacCMD + Option + S

mods.title: Vs Holy Quintet: DEBUT
mods.description: Vs. Holy Quintet is a new take on the world of Puella Magi Madoka Magica, this time through the eyes of a new star-struck protagonist, Girlfriend!A Friday Night Funkin’ mod set in a world of magic and miracles, join GF as she experiences the joys (and horrors) of this new world, all with the power of song! Featuring an original OST with 9 playable songs, a leaderboard system, cutscenes, and more!Sing against the magical girls of Mitakihara city: Sayaka Miki, Mami Tomoe, Madoka Kaname, Kyoko Sakura, and Homura Akemi, and wow the world with your magical tunes! How will Girlfriend fare in a world of hope and despair, where even kindness could spiral into the greatest of tragedies? All you have to do is make a wish to find out.
mods.author: Sector03

mods.title: VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY
mods.description: VS IMPOSTOR IS BACK!A from-the-ground-up remaster of the 2023 mod, VS IMPOSTOR V4! VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY intends to be faithful to the original experience, while introducing new tweaks and features to make it the definitive version of the mod you know and love!VS IMPOSTOR is a total-conversion mod for Friday Night Funkin', in which you face off against colorful Among Us characters. With over 10 weeks and 57 songs! this mod has plenty of content for you to explore, especially with brand-new awards and cosmetics for you to find and collect! And who knows? maybe there are more secrets to discover...OPTIMIZATIONTHE MOD IS ACTUALLY OPTIMIZED NOW... here's a little comparison of Danger alone... although in the real v4 nothing ever unloaded from your memory so by the time you'd get to danger on a fresh playthrough it'd probably be more like 4gigsLANGUAGEThis time around, the mod's not only in English! We've brought members of the community together and have translated the mod into 28 languages!EXPANDED COSMICUBE!Legacy's Cosmicube has been heavily expanded compared to the original from 2023. With tons of new skins and pets to find, you'll have a lot more to find and discover!AWARDSThere are 28 new awards for you to unlock! Will you get them all?BRAND-NEW DLC!With 5 new songs, and an entirely new Cosmicube, the SECURITY DLC will be made available when Legacy launches on April 25th!To install, just drag and drop the "securitydlc" folder into the content folderStill need help? Follow our video guide!MODDINGWanna make your own cosmicube? Add your own week or songs! Check out the official modding doc!

mods.title: VS. Mouse Ultimate [INCOMPLETE OFFICIAL RELEASE]
mods.description: Overview:A couple from Orlando encounter the hidden remnants of Disney's top-secret "W.O.N.D.E.R Initiative", where the now-bankrupt corporation recklessly attempted to make Mickey Mouse and his friends exist in real life. Their success was... pyrrhic.About This Game:Vs. Mouse ULTIMATE is a mod of the hit indie game "Friday Night Funkin'", serving as a complete overhaul of its father mod, "Vs. Mouse", with a fresh twist and a deeper narrative.This mod is cancelled, but we hope you enjoy what we had in store for you all mouse fans! We love you all so-so much and we spent a LOTTA time on this, and I must say.. it sure ended up beautiful.EPISODE 1 - Clubhouse Catastrophe: BF and GF discover a whole new, hidden world, where they meet Mickey Mouse and his friends! Surely this'll all be fun, right?...FREEPLAY: Legacy Variants of the songs shown off in Episode 1, including a secret song...? Try and find it, no peeking!INTERACTIVE MINIGAMES: Access the Credits Menu to play a fun clicking game! Just simply click the credit icons and you will receive clicks. For your time and dedication, you will also be receiving trophies! Will you be the one to get the rarest and highest one!?CUSTOMIZABLE OPTIONS: Not only are there minigames; you can also customize the options to your liking, including more secrets which were created during the mod's development! Feel free to check it out.IMPORTANT NOTE: This project is not directly affiliated with the developers of MOUSE! or Vs. Mouse ROOKIES EDITION. While we share the same base concept, as well as similar inspirations and ideas, we remain separate, individual games. Think of us as creative siblings embarking on parallel adventures! :))

mods.title: FNF ONLINE VS. Hank Challenge - Psych Engine Port
mods.description: This is a Psych Engine port of the first challenge in FNF ONLINE VS, the Hank Challenge (with the song's name being "Accelerant").This port is intended to be used with the ONLINE VS. Result Screen Port.A lot of people have already tried to port this challenge to psych, but most of these ports are rushed, inaccurate, and just stupidly lazy (written before TheConcealedCow made his port, which is very good as well and is definitly worth your time). In this port, however, I tried to put as much effort as I can and I wanted this port to be one of the best psych engine ports to date. I hope you'll enjoy this port as much as I enjoyed making it!Accelerant REDUXThe offical remix (by philiplol) for Accelerant, "Accelerant REDUX", is playable in this port as an unlockable song. It includes the new song with one difficulty ("madness"), and a few minor visual effects added. This was originally supposed to only be a preview for a full Accelerant REDUX mod, which would have had completely new visuals, animations and cutscenes, a "normal" difficulty and a few new mechanics, but I completely canceled it.Read the README.md file from this mod's folder if you're looking for more information about this port and the plans I have for its future
